title: Law to pilot hearing protection gear for police officers
summary: This bill would require the NYPD to run a one-year pilot program giving in-ear electronic hearing protection with a noise reduction rating of 25 decibels or more to officers who work outdoors, covering at least one precinct per borough. The NYPD would also have to share information on preventing hearing loss and, within two months after the pilot ends, report on its cost, participation and effectiveness. The law would expire 24 months after taking effect.
